alex-sales: Heads-up: Prospect wants to swap their streaming ingest to our SDK for a 5-day POC. Goals: structured JSON output, one tool call to fraud-svc, zero visible failures during cutover. Can we keep customer code changes minimal?
mira-se: Yes. Best path: provide a 1-file shim that preserves their current function signatures and proxies to our SDK. That avoids touching business logic.
dan-ml: Two technical risks: 1) warm KV cache for context continuity; 2) deduping if we fan-out to both systems during switch. We should use idempotency keys on requests.
ryan-devex: Shim idea OK. Quick Python shim snippet (one-liner idea):
```
# shim_stream.py
from redwood import Client
c=Client(api_key=os.getenv("POC_KEY"))
def send(req):
  return c.stream(req, stream=True)
```
SDK handles reconnects and function callbacks.
mira-se: For fan-out cutover (run both old and new) we'll need a dedupe layer using request-id + response-hash. Fan-out is helpful for warm caches and measuring parity.
dan-ml: Token estimate request: ask for 100 sample requests to simulate tokens. Rough calc: avg 70 tokens/request -> 50 rps = 210k tokens/min -> ~12.6M tokens/hr. Add ~15% for function-call payloads.
ryan-devex: Security: supply scoped ephemeral keys (TTL 1h) and HMAC for tool-callbacks. We'll provide a small rotation script in the runbook.
infra-bot: POC ticket created: POC-9981. Demo cluster target: 2025-05-18T08:00:00Z.
alex-sales: Pricing concern: customer worried about Dedicated. We propose hosted POC first. Estimate ballpark hosted cost after tokens glace.
mira-se: Action items: 1) Alex to collect 100 sample requests; 2) Dan to build token sim + dedupe design; 3) Ryan to drop shim + rotation script; 4) I'll draft acceptance criteria (schema pass on 20 gold examples, tool-call stub success >=95%, p50 latency <=250ms).
dan-ml: If they want private later, warn that air-gapped on-prem adds 3+ week lead time.
ryan-devex: I'll upload artifacts to shared drive by EOD and include cURL example for streaming function call.
alex-sales: Thanks — I'll lock demo slot with customer and ping when samples arrive. :calendar:
